critically_close: Move a bit farther from the screen.
too_close: Sit about an arm's length from the screen.
too_far: Sit a little closer to the screen.
head_too_low: Lift your head so your eyes meet the screen.
head_too_high: Lower your chin slightly and look at the screen.
head_tilted: Keep your head level, ears even.
head_turned: Turn your face toward the screen.
low_blink_rate: Blink a few times and look away from the screen.
break: You have been sitting a while. Stand and take a short break.
escalate: Posture is still off. Acknowledge to keep monitoring.
